source: Expert-curated public catalogs for Indian parents 33–50. Official platforms only. Impact scores are editorial, not a clinical claim.

items.title: The Social Dilemma
items.why: How feeds shape attention — useful before you hand a child a phone.
items.evidence: Documentary interviews with former platform designers; pair with family screen rules.
items.indiaNote: Watch on Netflix IN. Debrief: one family phone-free meal.

items.title: Inside Bill’s Brain
items.why: Innovation, philanthropy, and first-principles problem solving.
items.evidence: Docuseries on large-scale problem framing (sanitation, energy).
items.indiaNote: Netflix IN. One episode + one note: what problem would I fund at home?

items.title: Minimalism: A Documentary About the Important Things
items.why: Lifestyle clarity and less consumption — useful in a high-GST, high-stuff household.
items.evidence: Values-based spending, not a finance course.
items.indiaNote: YouTube / rental. Try a 7-day no-new-Amazon rule.

items.title: La Casa de Papel: The Phenomenon (making-of)
items.why: Team craft, pacing, and collaboration — entertainment with a work lesson.
items.evidence: Behind-the-scenes craft, not a crime how-to.
items.indiaNote: Netflix IN. Ask: who is the ‘Professor’ in our family week?

items.title: Chak De! India / Lagaan
items.why: Indian classics on leadership, grit, and team identity.
items.evidence: Widely used in Indian B-school case conversations on motivation.
items.indiaNote: Family film night. One question after: what did the captain do when the team lost?

items.title: Coursera / edX — AI, finance, psychology
items.why: Structured skill hours beat random YouTube. Audit one course at a time.
items.evidence: MOOCs with assessments; pick Yale ‘Science of Well-Being’ or a Python/AI intro.
items.indiaNote: Many have audit-for-free. Sunday 25 minutes, not a 12-week binge.

items.title: Crash Course Philosophy & Economics
items.why: Dense, cited explainers. Good for a commute.
items.indiaNote: Turn autoplay off. One episode, one sentence in notes.

items.title: TED Talks India Nayi Soch
items.why: Ideas in Hindi/English with Indian context — not only Silicon Valley frames.
items.evidence: TED editorial format; pick talks on education, cities, work.
items.indiaNote: Star/YouTube. Share one talk at dinner, not a lecture.

items.title: MasterClass — leadership, negotiation, creativity
items.why: Craft from practitioners. Optional paid; skip if budget is tight and use Stanford GSB instead.
items.indiaNote: If you skip the paywall, use the free Stanford GSB item in this pack.

items.title: Stanford Graduate School of Business
items.why: Management insights without a two-year MBA.
items.evidence: University channel; View From The Top and faculty shorts.
items.indiaNote: YouTube. 15 minutes before stand-up, not late-night doomscroll.

items.title: Janet Lansbury — Respectful Parenting
items.why: RIE-informed language: connect before correct. Fits Willow’s no-shame framing.
items.evidence: Practitioner channel grounded in Magda Gerber / RIE.
items.indiaNote: English. Translate the script into Gujarati/Hindi at home: short and proud.

items.title: Positive discipline (Parenting Junkie-style)
items.why: Warmth + limits without humiliation. Pair with Willow daily-care notes.
items.evidence: Positive Discipline (Nelsen) tradition — look for Adlerian, not fear-based channels.
items.indiaNote: Skip channels that shame children. Search ‘positive discipline preschool’.

items.title: Harvard Center on the Developing Child
items.why: Serve-and-return, toxic stress, executive function — the science behind Willow horizons.
items.evidence: Peer-reviewed synthesis from a university research centre.
items.indiaNote: Watch ‘InBrief: The Science of Serve & Return’ then try it at pickup.

items.title: UNICEF India / regional parenting
items.why: India-specific early childhood, immunisation, and responsive care — not only Western blogs.
items.indiaNote: Hindi + English. Pair with Willow country pack vaccines.

items.title: Mindful parenting + Varsity basics
items.why: Stress down, then money skills: Zerodha Varsity modules (index funds, SIPs) after a 4-minute breath.
items.evidence: Mindfulness for emotion regulation; Varsity is a widely used free India markets primer (not advice).
items.indiaNote: Varsity first, tips-WhatsApp never. This is education, not a stock tip.
